notes.title: The Armageddon Update - art, new romance, and quality update!
notes.notes:
In preparation for the Armageddon Expo in Auckland NZ, we are re-releasing Prince of Cats as The Nine Lives of Nim: Fortune's Fool. 

[u][b]Watch this space - next month we will release the fully voice acted update!
[/b][/u]
In today's update:
- Art fully upgraded to 16:9 ratio!
- New romance plotlines added!
- Name change to the game
- Minor quality updates
